messages:
alex: Quick note  spotted that when an org-key is exchanged into a project token the trace UI shows only the project as effective identity. Makes billing/ownership lookup annoying.
maria: Can you paste repro steps + header dump? want to check if header is lost at proxy or during indexing.
alex: Repro: create org key -> /v1/exchange -> call /v1/generate with header `X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-42`. Header `X-Redwood-Origin: org:acme` present at ingress but absent in indexed trace. Example:```
Authorization: Bearer orgkey-acme-xxx
X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-42
X-Redwood-Origin: org:acme
```
sahil: Confirmed ingress logs contain origin. Indexer flattens identity into `effective_identity` and overwrites origin when project is present. Proposal: emit `origin_org` as separate low-cardinality tag and surface in UI.
kevin: Cost/RBAC note: extra index increases telemetry costs and org names can be sensitive. Show origin only to users with `read_org` permission; consider hashing in analytics.
lucy: Product: agree conservative rollout. Add org-admin opt-out so some customers can disable origin propagation. Also prepare short changelog note.
alex: Rollout idea: feature flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` off by default. Enable in staging for 2w, collect metrics on presence and RBAC denials, then internal rollout.
sahil: Dev plan: preserve header in ingress envelope (infra), emit `origin_org` tag in telemetry (eng-ml), add badge + filter + RBAC check in console (eng-platform), implement opt-out at exchange (auth). I'll open mapping PR.
deploy-bot: flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` set ON in staging for team:eng-platform by lucy at 2026-03-22T10:12:03Z
alex: Thanks, keeping an eye on staging. Closing thread for now.
